Chapter 99 The Tragedy Of The Lone Ranger (Subscribe)

As for the fifth-order powerhouses, their characteristic is that they can transform their will into domains, and they can transform a certain piece of heaven and earth into the form of their will to exist and operate in a short period of time.

Just like a person who comprehends the will of ice, then in a plain or even a desert, he can distort the movement of the world through his will, making that area windy and snowy, and it is bitingly cold, so that in the world with his own will, Get the maximum bonus of strength.

But the field, this kind of thing is like a nuclear bomb, it is not something you can release immediately, it must have a medium and preparation time, its mobility is not very high, it can be said that it can be used as a strategic deterrent, and it can be used with Personal fights, then you can listen to it as a joke!

Therefore, many countries on the mainland have Tier 5 powerhouses. Basically, every kingdom has one or several Tier 5 powerhouses.

But it is very rare to actually go to the battlefield. Unless a country is about to be destroyed, or a war with a population of 100,000 is fought, it will take a long time. A fifth-order came out to open up the domain, to show the world his strength and dignity as a fifth-order powerhouse.

At other times, the fifth-level powerhouse hides in the capital, or belongs to his own cultivation place, becoming an ostrich like a cute baby, without any aggressiveness.

Of course, if you have some brain damage in your heart, fantasize about killing a fifth-order strong man, become famous in the whole continent in one fell swoop, and run to provoke him, those strong men don't mind torturing him to death, so as to show the strength of the fifth-level strong man majesty.

Therefore, in ordinary battles, if those fifth-tier powerhouses are not given enough time and preparations to open up their best signature field, then they will only be equivalent to a stronger will power and more genuine energy. It's just a deep fourth level.

Under such circumstances, even though Tier 5 is much stronger than the ordinary world, if there are some powerful forces who are willing to sacrifice a large number of Tier 4s, they will send a dozen or twenty of Tier 4s to attack.

Even those fifth-tier powerhouses had to drink their hatred and flee in defeat. This was one of the reasons why those fifth-tier powerhouses did not dare to provoke the royal families of those countries and the major forces.

It's not that they don't dare to toughen up in front of those powerful leaders, but in fact it's useless for them to be tough.

For every major force, there are dozens of him at the bottom, and there are even hundreds of him for the stronger ones. For them, they have enough inheritance background, a little bit of the fourth rank, and form some powerful formations .

You can kill those fifth-order powerhouses who have no foundation, and you don't have to pay too much. Going to fight against them alone, isn't that courting death? And it doesn't make any sense to die!

Therefore, those fifth ranks are generally not very good at provoking those big forces, and those big forces will not be so stupid as to push those fifth ranks to the extreme!

On the contrary, they will be kind enough to recruit them to join their camp, to increase the background of their camp, so as to deal with the confrontation and struggle between the kingdoms of the entire continent!

Generally speaking, as long as they have reached the level of the fifth order, there are some contacts and face between the top leaders of various countries, and they are still very kind to each other, unless there is really something unforgivable between them. Only one side can resolve it!

With Zhong Yu's current strength, in each world, it is equivalent to the fifth level without expanding the domain, and it will take a while for the fifth level to open the domain, but this time is just enough for Zhong Yu to escape.

It is even possible to counter-kill some fifth-tier powerhouses who are not good at fighting, beat him in a hurry, and kill him before he can react. Let's talk about those talented fourth-tier powerhouses on the mainland, who often use it to become famous in one fell swoop and kill enemies by leapfrogging their ranks.

Generally speaking, with Zhong Yu's strength, on this entire continent, unless you encounter demigods who have transcended mortals and are already evolving to gods, or are directly gods, basically there will be no big problems. Dangerous, as long as he is careful enough!

But being cautious is precisely Zhong Yu's instinct and duty as an emperor. He must bring a large number of guards with him when he goes in and out, and he must send people to scout carefully days and months in advance when he goes through the route.

Basically, it can be said that any enemy has been eliminated, and the ambushes and siege are organized and purposeful, while other mortal powerhouses who are half gods come to besiege and kill Zhong Yu alone or with a few people. Doesn't he have those powerhouses?

As for some people may ask, isn't Zhong Yu able to exchange those strong men? Why not just exchange it for a demigod, or even a god? Isn't it possible to flatten the entire plain in this way, so there is no need to be so timid? Are you trying to come and go?

Yes, Zhong Yu also knew this truth, but why didn't he do it? He has been there and asked the system carefully if it can be exchanged for demigods, even if it requires millions of luck points, he is willing to do so.

Because he understands very well that an absolute strongman who has reached the level of a god can slaughter them all alone, and he has spent more than 1 million soldiers and their families exchanged for luck!

You don't even need to pay a big price, you may not even suffer injuries, all you need is a little time to search for the time for these ants to hide and escape.

Faced with such an advantageous and powerful combat force, Zhong Yu was of course extremely jealous, and wanted to exchange it for a long time, so that he could directly push the entire plain, complete himself as a god-level existence, and establish a heavenly court that governs the heavens and worlds, so that He was able to break the curse that he was cursed and could only live to 100 years.

However, the system told itself that beings who could become gods, or even demigods who were just stepping into the steps of life, were unique existences among the heavens and worlds of the entire universe.

Their life imprint is to directly prove themselves to the whole Dao, so as to be awarded and recognized by the Dao, and to obtain the qualification and recognition of promotion to the level of life!

Just like the ancient imperial examinations, you must first be a citizen of this country (Da Dao) before you can take part in the imperial examinations level by level (level by level) by learning various economics and classics. After being recognized by the competent imperial examination officials (Tiandao) in various places, after reaching the highest level, they will go to the emperor (Dao) to take the exam personally, and then they will be eligible to be an official under the emperor (Chengshen).

And the system also said that although he is above the Dao of Heaven, he is at the same level as the Dao, and even compared to the Dao, he is extremely weak, but his life was at the same level!

Therefore, if you want to get the license to directly become a god from him, you don't even need to think about it now. What the system can do is to spread Zhong Yu's influence to his subordinates!

This allows his subordinates to convert the permits granted by the Dao into those granted by the system when they achieve the Divine Mansion, thereby achieving an indirect control effect!

As for how to control it, there are several methods, and each method has its own advantages, so here is another detailed explanation!
